text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Thank you for agreeing to attend my<n>birthday party.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
This will be my way of giving back to<n>you. So
please, enjoy tonight.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well, thank you for inviting me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In case there's anything you're<n>unsure about, I
know my way around<n>the venue, so don't hesitate
to ask.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah, even a birthday party isn't safe<n>from your
power grabs. Kris S is the<n>host, not you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Sorry, it's a bad habit<n>of mine. I will
enjoy tonight as a<n>guest and nothing more.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please look forward to it. Thanks<n>to Sirius's
help, everything is in order.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Tch. Quiet. You don't have to tell her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Please do, I'd love to hear more.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
She handled everything I was unsure<n>about. She's
even going to pilot the<n>surprise airplane.
